description: Fix the DST drift in the room-booking meeting shifter: it adds whole days as absolute seconds on a naive copy and stamps the original offset back on, so meetings crossing a Europe/Warsaw CET/CEST transition move by an hour on the wall clock; the hidden gate replays both 2024 transitions plus the no-transition regressions.

criteria: scheduler.py shifts meetings on the local wall clock across DST transitions - a 09:30 Europe/Warsaw slot stays 09:30 with the offset recomputed for the target day (CET vs CEST), for naive and aware input alike - and weekly_slots and describe line up with it again, without touching the gate or the README.
